page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Below a rule, a Hebrew-letter heading, then verse stanzas. No margin notes.

p.i: Sic me procul serena Solatium reliquit Suaue pacis: ut, quid Sit ocium, aut secunda Res non magis recorder.
Meis simul recisus Fugit vigor lacertis, Mens sauciata clamat Sperare quid Supremi Opem iuuat parentis?

main_text.head: ZAIIM. HETH. TETH.
main_text.p: Afflicta tamen ô tandem miserescere gentis Rex bone cœlituum. Pelle procul quæ me torquent absinthia & omnem Fellis amariciem. Quæ mala dum tristi percurro mente (fatiscat Languida vita licet) Hærent illa tamen semper sub pectore fixa, Et meminisse iuvat, Quid? me damnorum tanta sub mole iacentem Spes animosa fouet. Namque Dei bonitas Solymæ miserata labores Proteget Abramidum

page.notes: The first line "Corpus tegit iacentem." is the end of a stanza continued from the previous page. The verse is printed in italic. The large initials A, P and Q are part of their words. The rule above the heading is ornamental and is not transcribed. Spelling is kept as printed except for u/v and i/j.
